newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's NTN buys Federal-Mogul ball bearing arm.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NTN buys Federal-Mogul ball bearing arm.

text.p: Japanese bearing maker NTN Corp said on Monday that it agreed with Federal-Mogul Corp of the United States on September 27 to buy the U.S. company's ball bearing arm.
The purchase includes Federal-Mogul's two factories as well as ball bearing technology and marketing operations.
The move will boost NTN's ball bearing production in the U.S. by 50 percent, with the possibility that the products may be exported to Japan, the company said in a statement.
The firm also hopes to expand NTN's customer portfolio, the statement said.
The price of the purchase was not disclosed.
NTN also said it had set up a new company, NTN-BCA Corp, in Pennsylvania to manage the purchased operations.
The new firm is a wholly owned subsidiary of NTN USA Corp, NTN's U.S. subsidiary.
